changes: Both configure_all and poll_drivers prepare ALL5 modules with write-only SENDDELAY2 before any read batch. This includes ARM/MOVE checks beforeCHECK and refreshes a node reset between batches.
read_register rejects requests before bootstrap and waits150us after accepted replies or failed timeout, then drains on failure.
The write-only SLAVECONF0x03 is written again after IFCNTbaseline; delta7 covers all7 configuration writes, including SENDDELAY. No nonexistent readback is invented.
Runtime uses shared UART baud/idle/send-delay constants and tested IFCNTwrap helper.
portable_test_scope: All256 IFCNT baselines exercise expected7writes and reject6/8, plus invalid256count and protocol register/timing requirements. Runtime helper is used for actual configuration validation. Root must run host and ARM builds after these edits.
